!rules:
📜 LEAGUE RULES DIRECTORY
Type a command to view details:

• !draft – Draft order & roster limits
• !keepers – Keeper declarations & costs
• !waivers – FAAB & transaction limits
• !payouts – Prize money & weekly bonuses
• !fees – Dues & penalty fines
!draft:
🏈 DRAFT RULES:
• 19 rounds total.
• Pick choice based on regular season and playoff finishes.
• Duplicate draft attempt fine: $1 per mistake.
!keepers:
🔒 KEEPER RULES:
• Max 1 keeper per team.
• Must declare 48 hours before draft night.
• Cost: 4 rounds prior to original draft round.
!waivers:
⚡ WAIVER RULES:
• $100 FAAB starting budget.
• Weeks 1–4: 5 free pickups max, then $10 per extra.
• Weeks 5+: 2 free pickups max, then $5 per extra.
!payouts:
💰 PAYOUTS:
• Weekly High Score: $20/week
• Season Highest Total Points: $100
• Position Group Leaders: $25 each (QB, RB, WR, TE)
!fees:
⚠️ FEES & FINES:
• Entry Fee: $180 (due before draft).
• Weekly Low Score Fine: $5
• Extra Pickups: $5–$10 depending on week.
